PANEL_MODULE_SETTINGS_PLACEHOLDER: No module-specific options for this panel type yet.
SETTINGS_DMX_REINIT_DESC: Reconnects all DMX interfaces (Art-Net, sACN, USB) without restarting the application.
RESET_CONFIRM_MESSAGE: Really reset all settings to their default values?
NEW_SHOW_CONFIRM: Create a new show? Unsaved changes will be lost.
UNSAVED_CHANGES_BODY: The current show has unsaved changes. Do you want to save before continuing?
FX_EMPTY: No fixtures patched yet — click 'Add Fixtures' to get started.
FX_OVERFLOW_WARN: Warning: end address {end} exceeds 512 in Universe {univ}. Reduce quantity or start address.
FX_DELETE_BODY_ONE: Really delete '{name}'? This cannot be undone.
FX_DELETE_BODY_MANY: Really delete {n} fixtures? This cannot be undone.
FXPROG_EMPTY: No fixtures patched — click 'Add' to get started.
FXPROG_DMX_EMPTY: Select a fixture to view its DMX channels
CMDLINE_PLACEHOLDER: Enter command... (e.g. Fixture 1 At 80 Zoom 50, Go; Tab = suggestions)
BLACKOUT_TITLE: Blackout: all brightness off / back on (command: Blackout)
PRESET_EMPTY: No presets yet. Click '+ Preset' to add one.
CUE_CMD_PLACEHOLDER: Separate several commands with comma or semicolon: Fixture 1 At 100; Fixture 2 At 0
CUELIST_EMPTY: No cues yet. Program some values and click 'Save Cue'.
CUE_CTX_JUMP: Jump to This Cue / Fade Here
LAYOUT_DELETE_BODY: Really delete layout "{name}"? This cannot be undone.
UPDATE_MAIN_DEVICE_ONLY: Install it on the computer that runs OpenCue.
UPDATE_NONE: No release has been published yet.
UPDATE_OFFLINE: Could not check for updates. Is this computer online?
UPDATE_RATE_LIMIT: GitHub is limiting requests right now. Try again later.
UPDATE_ERR_CHECKSUM: The download is damaged (checksum does not match). Nothing was installed.
UPDATE_ERR_NETWORK: The download failed. Check the connection or use the release page.
SETTINGS_UPDATE_CHECK_HINT: At startup OpenCue asks GitHub whether a newer version exists. This needs internet; without a connection nothing happens and OpenCue keeps working offline.
ABOUT_NOTICE: This program comes with ABSOLUTELY NO WARRANTY. This is free software, and you are welcome to redistribute it under certain conditions; see the license for details.
ABOUT_THIRD_INTRO: OpenCue uses the following components. Tap one to read its license.
ABOUT_NO_TEXT: No license text is bundled for this component.
WIDGET_CONFIG_FADER_COMMAND_HINT: Use {value} as placeholder, e.g.  Fixture 1 At {value}
STORAGE_CONFIRM_CHANGE_MSG: Change the data path to {path}? New showfiles, layouts and fixtures will be saved and loaded from there.
STORAGE_CONFIRM_RESET_MSG: Reset the storage path back to the default folder (%LOCALAPPDATA%\OpenCue)?
CLOSE_CONFIRM_BODY: Do you really want to quit the program?
FXE_EMPTY: No effects yet. Click '+ Effect' to create one.
FXS_NEW_HINT: New template loaded - not saved yet.
SETTINGS_REMOTE_PASSWORD_SHORT: The password needs at least 4 characters.
SETTINGS_REMOTE_RESTART: A changed port takes effect after restarting OpenCue.
SETTINGS_REMOTE_STATUS_ON: Reachable on the network - open this address in the iPad's browser:
SETTINGS_REMOTE_STATUS_OFF: Local only ({url}) - nothing gets in from the network.
SETTINGS_REMOTE_STATUS_NONET: Enabled, but no network was found. Check the connection and click "Detect addresses again".
SETTINGS_REMOTE_PENDING: Click "Save & Apply" to apply the change right away (no restart needed).
SETTINGS_REMOTE_CANDIDATES: Once enabled, the console is reachable at these addresses:
SETTINGS_REMOTE_COPY_FAILED: Copying is not possible - select the address and copy it by hand.
SETTINGS_REMOTE_QR: Scan with the camera (iPad, phone). The password is asked when connecting.
SETTINGS_REMOTE_PORT_INVALID: The port must be between 1024 and 65535.
REMOTE_KICKED: You were disconnected by the host. Reload the page to sign in again.
WAKELOCK_UNSUPPORTED: Keeping the screen awake is not possible over http on the network (browsers only allow it over HTTPS). Set the device's auto-lock to "Never".
wakeLock_unsupported: Screen lock prevention is not supported by this browser or in HTTP mode. Set the device's auto-lock to "Never".
THEME_STATUS_HINT: Changing a status color away from green, yellow or red makes states harder to recognize.
THEME_TRANSFER_PLACEHOLDER: Theme as JSON – paste here to import
THEME_EXPORT_COPIED: Theme JSON copied to the clipboard.
THEME_IMPORT_INVALID: That is not a valid theme.
THEME_IMPORT_OK: Theme loaded – apply it with "Save & Apply".
FXS_DELETE_FORBIDDEN: Only scripts in the user folder can be deleted.
LAYOUT_UPDATED_APPLIED: Layout “{name}” was updated by another device.
LAYOUT_UPDATED_PENDING: This layout was updated by another device
FULLSCREEN_UNSUPPORTED: This browser does not allow fullscreen. Tip: add the page to the home screen to run it as an app.
FXPROG_POS_FINE_NONE: The selected fixture has no fine channel for pan/tilt.
FXPROG_POS_FINE_SOME: {n} of {m} selected fixtures have a fine channel – only those use the fine values.
FXPROG_POS_SWIPE_HINT: Tap a number to type, swipe up/down on it to change it.
SETTINGS_LAYOUT_SWIPE_HINT: Applies to this device only. A clear horizontal swipe outside lists, faders and input fields switches to the next/previous layout.
LAYOUT_NEW_DIRTY_WARNING: Unsaved changes to the current layout will be lost.
SHOWFILE_DELETE_LOADED_NOTE: It is currently loaded: the show in memory is kept and counts as unsaved afterwards.
EXEC_LIST_AUTO: Active list (from the cue list panel)
EXEC_FADER_TIP: Mix: 100 % = full cue value, 0 % = manual value (not the overall brightness)
CUELIST_SAVE_CUE_TIP: Store the programmer state as a new cue or onto an existing number
CUELIST_UPDATE_TIP: Take the current values into the active cue
CUE_STORE_HINT_EXISTS: Cue {n} "{name}" already exists - when storing you choose Merge or Overwrite.
CUE_STORE_ERR_RANGE: The number must be between {lower} and {upper}.
CUE_STORE_ERR_RANGE_END: The number must be greater than {lower}.
CUE_CONFLICT_BODY: Cue {n} "{name}" already exists. How should it be stored?
CUE_CONFLICT_RENUMBER_BODY: Cue {n} "{name}" already exists. Merge takes the content of this cue into the existing one, Overwrite replaces the existing cue with this one.
CUE_CONFLICT_MERGE_HINT: Only the changed channels go into the cue, the rest stays as it was.
CUE_CONFLICT_OVERWRITE_HINT: The complete previous content is deleted and replaced by the current state.
CUE_UPDATE_BODY: Takes the current values into cue {n} "{name}".
CUE_UPDATE_NORMAL_HINT: Only this cue changes. Following cues that do not set these values themselves take them over when played (tracking).
CUE_UPDATE_ONLY_HINT: The change stays on this cue: the following cue keeps its previous look.
CUE_ERR_EMPTY: Nothing to store: set values or assign an effect.
CUE_ERR_NO_ACTIVE: No active cue in this list - start a cue first.
CUE_ERR_RANGE: The number is outside the neighbouring cues.
CUE_DELAY_SWIPE_TIP: Delay: swipe up/down to change the value (all selected cues together), tap to type
EXEC_PROP_SMART: Smart layout (large Go, the other buttons below)
CUE_DELETE_MULTI_BODY: Delete {n} cues? This cannot be undone.
EXEC_PROP_SHOW_TITLE: Show title (cue list and current position)
CUELIST_DELETE_LIST_TIP: Delete the whole cue list including all its cues
CUELIST_DELETE_LIST_BODY: Permanently delete cue list “{name}” with {n} cue(s)? Executors using this list switch to the active list.
CUE_ERR_TRIGGER: Invalid trigger - allowed: Go, Follow or Timecode (e.g. "tc 4.3").
CUE_ERR_MIB: Invalid MIB value - allowed: On/Off, 1/0, True/False or Auto.
SHORTCUTS_SIM3D_DUPLICATE: Duplicate Object (press again to repeat the offset)
SHORTCUTS_SIM3D_NUDGE: Move Selection (Shift = 5x); no layout switch while selected
SIMSTAGE_SAVE_TIP: Writes the active stage to its file (a new stage asks for a name).
SIMSTAGE_REPLACE_BODY: "{name}" has unsaved changes that are lost when replaced. Replace?
SIMSTAGE_CHIP_DIRTY: Stage has unsaved changes - manage stages
CUELIST_PROP_LIST_HINT: Only used when the list selector is hidden: the panel then always shows this list.
FXGRP_DELETE_BODY: Delete group “{name}”? The fixtures are kept, they just no longer belong to a group.
FXGRP_HEADER_TIP: Click: select / deselect all fixtures of this group
FXGRP_EMPTY: Empty – assign fixtures via right-click → “Edit fixture…”
FXGRP_ERR_DUP: A group with this name already exists.
FXGRP_ERR_INVALID: The group could not be changed.
FX_PROPS_SORT_HINT: Free value. Empty = the fixture number (FID); a number (decimals allowed, e.g. 2.5) places it accordingly.
FXLIB_EMPTY_INSTALLED: No fixtures installed yet. Search under “Online” or import a GDTF file.
FXLIB_LOGIN_INFO: GDTF Share is the official, free collection of GDTF files. A free account is required to download. The password is kept in memory for this session only and is never stored.
FXLIB_DROP_HINT: Drop GDTF files here to import
FXLIB_ERR_INVALID_FILE: This is not a valid GDTF file.
FXLIB_ERR_TOO_LARGE: The file is too large (max. 30 MB).
FXLIB_ERR_IN_USE: Used by fixtures in the show.
FXDET_NO_CHANNELS: This mode has no DMX channels.
FXDET_ERR: The details could not be loaded.
FXLIB_REMEMBER: Stay signed in (password stored encrypted on this computer)
FXLIB_PROFILE_TIP: Opens gdtf-share.com in the browser – manage your account and profile there
FXLIB_LOGOUT_TIP: Sign out and forget a stored login
FXLIB_ERR_RATE: Too many requests – please wait {s} s.
FXLIB_REFRESH_THROTTLED: The list is current (loaded {s} s ago) – it can only be reloaded once a minute.
FXLIB_OLD_KEPT: The old revision stays installed because the show uses it.
MEDIA_MISSING: The file is missing (it was not saved in the show file) – please upload it again
MEDIA_NOT_IN_SHOW: This media does not belong to the loaded show
MEDIA_PLAY_ERR: The browser cannot play this format
MEDIA_LIST_EMPTY: No media yet. Upload a video or audio file.
MEDIA_START_HINT: The media starts when the timecode reaches this time and follows it (also when jumping and running backwards).
MEDIA_ERR_TOO_LARGE: The file is too large (max. 1 GB).
MEDIA_ERR_TYPE: This is not a supported video/audio file (MP4, WebM, OGG, WAV, MP3, FLAC, AAC, M4A).
CUE_EDIT_TIMECODE_HINT: The cue fires when the running timecode reaches this time, e.g. 4.3 or 00:00:04.300. It does not fire when jumping or running backwards.
MEDIA_START_DIALOG_HINT: Examples: 12.5 (seconds), 1:30 or 00:00:12.500. The media starts when the running timecode reaches this time; before that it waits at the beginning.
MEDIA_REMOVED_DELETED: Media removed – the copy was also deleted from the computer.
MEDIA_REMOVED_OTHER: Media removed – the file stays on the computer because the show “{show}” still uses it.
MEDIA_REMOVE_BODY_COPY: The media is removed from this show and the copy on this computer is deleted – unless another saved show still needs it.
MEDIA_START_QUESTION: At which timecode should the {kind} start?
SHOWFILE_MEDIA_DELETED: {n} media file(s) only this show needed were deleted too.
PANEL_DESC_DMX_MONITOR: Shows the DMX values of the universes live.
PANEL_DESC_FIXTURES: List of patched fixtures: select, patch, edit.
PANEL_DESC_PROGRAMMER: Set values of the selected fixtures (dimmer, color, position ...).
PANEL_DESC_PRESETS: Recall stored variables and effects quickly.
PANEL_DESC_CUELIST: Create, edit and play cue lists.
PANEL_DESC_EXECUTOR: Run one cue list with fader, Go and pause.
PANEL_DESC_COMMAND_NUMPAD: Number pad for entering commands by touch.
PANEL_DESC_BUTTON: Your own button that runs a command.
PANEL_DESC_FADER: Your own fader, for example for a dimmer or master.
PANEL_DESC_TIMECODE: Global timeline with start, stop, speed and cue triggering.
PANEL_DESC_MEDIA_PLAYER: Plays video or audio, optionally in sync with the timecode.
PANEL_DESC_STREAM: Shows a livestream (camera address) or a camera attached to the main device.
PANEL_DESC_SIM3D: Shows the stage in 3D (step 1: empty stage with floor and coordinate system, move the camera with mouse or touch).
SIM3D_NO_WEBGL: 3D display (WebGL) is not available on this device.
SIM3D_FIXTURES_EMPTY: The show has no fixtures yet.
SIM3D_FIXTURES_HINT: Tap a fixture in the list to put it on the stage. Tap in the view to select, Shift-click for several, drag to move.
SIM3D_FIXTURE_SCALE_TIP: Size of the 3D model; 1 = original size from the fixture file
SIM3D_FIXTURE_MODEL_REAL: 3D model from the fixture file, {size} m (at scale 1)
SIM3D_FIXTURE_MODEL_GENERIC: Simple default model: the fixture file has no 3D model.
SIM3D_FIXTURE_POSITION_TIP: Hanging point of the fixture (meters); Z = height
SIM3D_FIXTURE_ROTATION_TIP: Orientation in degrees; 0 = hanging, lens pointing down
SIM3D_AIM_FINISH_TIP: Leave aiming mode (Esc); point and lines disappear
FXPROG_AIM_AUTO_FOCUS_TIP: Focus to the distance where the beam hits a surface of the 3D simulation
FXPROG_AIM_AUTO_ZOOM_TIP: Zoom so the light circle where the beam hits a surface has a given radius
FXPROG_AIM_MISS: No beam hits a surface of the 3D simulation.
FXPROG_AIM_RADIUS_LABEL: Radius of the light circle in metres
FXPROG_AIM_CLAMPED: {n} fixtures cannot quite reach the radius (zoom at its limit).
FXPROG_AIM_NONE_TIP: Select moving heads that are placed in the 3D simulation
FXPROG_AIM_SET_TIP: Tap a target in the 3D simulation: the selected moving heads aim at it (Esc leaves)
SIM3D_EMPTY: No objects yet - add one above.
SIM3D_SELECT_HINT: Tap an object in the list or in the view.
SIM3D_POSITION_TIP: Base point of the object (middle of the underside): Z is the height above the floor.
SIM3D_DELETE_MANY_BODY: Do you really want to delete the {n} selected objects?
SIM3D_SNAP_TIP: While dragging, position, size and rotation (5°) snap.
SIM3D_DROP_TIP: Moves the object so that its lowest point rests on the floor.
SIM3D_MATERIAL_TIP: Surface of the object: matte (wood, stone, fabric) to mirror (chrome). The color stays freely selectable.
SIM3D_SPOT_TIP: A single test spot to judge the light cone, the light circle and shadows on slanted surfaces. It is not saved.
SIM3D_SPOT_AIM_TIP: Point the spot aims at. The yellow ball in the view can be dragged onto a surface.
SIM3D_QUALITY_TIP: Display quality (click to change). Auto adapts the resolution to the device's performance; numbers: frames per second and megapixels.
SIM3D_QUALITY_SOFTWARE: Warning: graphics are rendered in software (no GPU acceleration) - this is slow.
SIM3D_BOUNCE_TIP: How strongly each light source brightens the whole room (0 % = only the lit spot glows).
SIM3D_ROOM_HINT: All settings apply to all devices.
SIM3D_BLEED_TIP: Lit surfaces tint their surroundings in their color (blue box = bluish walls next to it).
SIM3D_REFLECT_TIP: How strongly glossy surfaces (paint, plastic, metal) mirror the room.
SIM3D_HAZE_TIP: Haze in the room: makes the beams of the fixtures visible
SIM3D_ROOM_RESET_TIP: Reset all lighting settings to the defaults
SIM3D_ROOM_RESET_BODY: Do you really want to reset all settings for light, reflection and colors to the defaults? This applies to all devices.
SIM3D_HOUSE_TIP: Lighting of the room itself, in Build and View. 0 % = pitch dark.
SIM3D_SHELL_TIP: How brightly walls and ceiling bounce light back.
STREAM_ERR_GENERIC: The stream could not be loaded
STREAM_ERR_INVALID_URL: Please enter a valid address (http:// or https://)
STREAM_ERR_SCHEME: Browsers cannot play RTSP/RTMP. A converter such as MediaMTX or go2rtc turns it into WebRTC, HLS or MJPEG.
STREAM_ERR_SELF: That is the address of this program itself
STREAM_ERR_AUTH: The camera rejects the user name/password
STREAM_ERR_NOT_FOUND: The camera does not know this address (404)
STREAM_ERR_UPSTREAM: The camera answers with an error
STREAM_ERR_FOREIGN: The camera redirects to another server (blocked)
STREAM_ERR_BUSY: Too many simultaneous connections to this camera
STREAM_ERR_LOAD: No picture: check address, type or credentials
STREAM_ERR_HLS_UNSUPPORTED: This browser does not play HLS. Use MJPEG or WebRTC.
STREAM_ERR_WEBRTC_UNSUPPORTED: This browser does not support WebRTC
STREAM_ERR_CAM_DENIED: Windows denies camera access (Settings > Privacy > Camera)
STREAM_ERR_CAM_NONE: This camera is no longer connected to the main device
STREAM_ERR_CAM_BUSY: The camera is busy (another program is using it)
STREAM_SRC_INTRO: Credentials go in the fields below, not into the address. The password is stored encrypted on this computer and is never sent to clients.
STREAM_SRC_PW_NOTE: Without Windows the password is only kept until the program ends.
STREAM_SRC_PROXY_HINT: The server fetches the stream and passes it on. Needed with a password, for cameras without CORS permission, or when a device cannot reach the camera directly.
STREAM_REMOVE_BODY: Panels showing this source will show no stream afterwards. The camera itself is not changed.
STREAM_CAM_NO_FFMPEG: Cameras on the main device need ffmpeg.exe: put the file into the ffmpeg folder inside the program folder (download: ffmpeg.org or gyan.dev) or add ffmpeg to the PATH, then press "Find cameras again".
STREAM_CAM_NONE_FOUND: No camera was found on the main device. Connect one and press "Find cameras again".
STREAM_CAM_UNSUPPORTED: Cameras on the main device are available on Windows and Linux.
STREAM_VIA_HOST: Camera on the main device, streamed by the server
STREAM_ERR_NO_FFMPEG: ffmpeg.exe is missing on the main device (put it into the ffmpeg folder inside the program folder or add it to the PATH)
STREAM_ERR_CAM_FAILED: The camera on the main device delivers no picture
STREAM_ERR_CAM_UNSUPPORTED: Cameras on the main device are available on Windows and Linux
STREAM_ERR_CAM_LOST: The camera on the main device delivers nothing any more (unplugged or taken by another program)
STREAM_Q_HINT: Applies to cameras on the main device. The camera runs at the highest level any panel currently asks for and only drops back at the next camera start. Higher levels need much more Wi-Fi bandwidth per device.
FXDET_MODELS_NO_READER: The assimp-py library is missing (pip install -r requirements.txt)
FXDET_NO_WHEELS: This type has no gobo or color wheels.
FXDET3D_NONE: There is no 3D data for this type.
FXDET3D_NO_READER: The 3D files of this type cannot be read: the assimp-py library is missing (pip install -r requirements.txt).
FXDET3D_ERR: The 3D data could not be loaded.
FXDET3D_FROM_FILES: Models from the 3D files of the GDTF
FXDET3D_FROM_PRIMS: No 3D files in the GDTF: the described primitive shapes are shown
FXDET3D_HINT: Drag: rotate · wheel or two fingers: zoom · right-click/Shift+drag: move · double-click: reset
FXLIB_SHOW_HINT: The show "{name}" uses these fixtures. Their files are stored in the show file: you can export the show and open it on any other device without installing anything. Add and remove fixtures in the fixture list.
FXLIB_SHOW_EMPTY: This show does not use any fixtures yet. Fixtures are created in the fixture list panel.
FXLIB_SHOW_SRC_LIBRARY: Added to the show file when saving
FXLIB_SHOW_KEEPS_COPY: The current show uses this type; it stays stored in the show file.
FXLIB_UNINSTALL_IN_USE_TIP: Used by the current show - it stays stored in the show file.
FM_HINT_THEMES: Color profiles (theme): colors and rounding of the interface
FM_THEME_UNSAVED: Custom theme - not saved as a profile yet
FM_THEME_SAVE_TITLE: Save the current theme as a color profile
FM_HINT_SHOWS: Show files: fixtures, cues, presets, effects, stage
FM_HINT_FIXTURES: GDTF files of the fixture library
FM_BACKUP_TIP: Download all files of all kinds as a ZIP
FM_EXPORT_SHOW_TIP: Download the loaded show with its files as a ZIP package
FM_EMPTY: No files. Add some with "Upload" or by dropping them here.
FM_DELETE_FIXTURE_BODY: Really delete "{name}"? Shows that use the type will no longer find their file (an export package contains it).
FM_EXPORT_INTRO: The show "{name}" is downloaded as a ZIP package. Only things this show uses are included. Choose what to add:
FM_EXPORT_DIRTY: Unsaved changes of the show are included in the export.
FM_IMPORT_SHOW_TIP: Read in a show (.json) or an export package (.zip)
FM_IMPORTED_OPEN: "{name}" is now in the list. Open it now?
FM_NAME_TAKEN: "{name}" already exists. Please choose another name.
FM_UPLOAD_COPY: "{name}" already existed with different content: saved as "{copy}"
FM_FIXLIB_INFO: These are the installed fixture files (GDTF). To search, import and download new fixtures use the fixture library.
FXS_DISCARD_BODY: The effect has unsaved changes. They will be lost.
FXS_DELETE_BODY: Really delete effect “{name}”? This cannot be undone.
FXS_PV_ERROR: The script has an error – the preview shows the last good state.
FM_RESTORE_FX_INFO: Missing bundled effects are created again. Existing and your own effects stay unchanged.
FM_RESTORE_NONE: All default effects are already there.
FXS_CAT_COLOR_D: Controls color: r, g, b (0 to 255 each).
FXS_CAT_POSITION_D: Controls pan and tilt (0 to 100 %, 50 = center).
FXS_DELETE_TIP: Delete this effect from the user folder
FXS_DELETE_TIP_NONE: Only saved effects in the user folder can be deleted. Delete others via “Open...” (trash can) or the file manager.
FXS_HELP_ERROR: The guide could not be loaded.
FXS_TPL_DIMMER_EMPTY_D: A fixed value – a starting point for your own ideas.
FXS_TPL_DIMMER_SINE_D: Soft up and down. speed = waves per second, spread = offset between fixtures.
FXS_TPL_DIMMER_PULSE_D: Hard on and off. duty = share of the period the light is on.
FXS_TPL_DIMMER_CHASE_D: One light travels across the fixtures (in selection order).
FXS_TPL_DIMMER_FLICKER_D: Jumps to random brightness values and fades softly there (shows variables, if and random).
FXS_TPL_COLOR_EMPTY_D: A fixed color – a starting point for your own ideas.
FXS_TPL_COLOR_RAINBOW_D: Walks through all hues with hsv(); spread distributes them across the fixtures.
FXS_TPL_COLOR_TWO_D: Soft crossfade between two colors (two color pickers).
FXS_TPL_COLOR_RANDOM_D: Switches to random hues; speed = changes per second.
FXS_TPL_POS_EMPTY_D: Fixed center – a starting point for your own ideas.
FXS_TPL_POS_CIRCLE_D: Pan and tilt travel a circle.
FXS_TPL_POS_EIGHT_D: A lying eight made of two sine waves.
FXS_CAT_BLANK_D: No header lines and no template – you write everything yourself.
FXS_TPL_GENERIC_EMPTY_D: Sets all outputs to their neutral value.
FXS_EMPTY: Empty file. Start with #CATEGORY dimmer (or color / position) and loop() – all commands are listed under “Help”.
FXS_CAT_GOBO_D: Selects gobos: gobo (0 to 100 %); slots and slot(n) pick gobos of the fixture.
FXS_TPL_ZOOM_EMPTY_D: A fixed zoom – a starting point for your own ideas.
FXS_TPL_ZOOM_PULSE_D: The zoom swings softly between low and high.
FXS_TPL_ZOOM_BEAT_D: Snaps open, then slowly back – like a beat.
FXS_TPL_FOCUS_EMPTY_D: A fixed focus – a starting point for your own ideas.
FXS_TPL_FOCUS_BREATHE_D: The focus breathes softly between low and high.
FXS_TPL_GOBO_EMPTY_D: The first gobo of the fixture – a starting point for your own ideas.
FXS_TPL_GOBO_CYCLE_D: Steps through all gobos of the fixture in turn.
PRESET_ENABLE: Store this value in the preset
PRESET_POSITION_HINT: Coarse sets whole percent, Fine the range in between (16 bit if the fixture has a fine channel). The number field also takes exact values like 33.3333.
PRESET_GOBO_HINT: Only ticked values are stored and set when the preset is recalled. Gobo wheel = pick a static gobo, rotation = spin or shake the gobo (value range of the fixture).
FXS_OPEN_NO_FAVORITES: No favorites yet - mark an effect with the star.
FXE_NAME_PLACEHOLDER: Leave empty for an automatic name (e.g. Position_1)
FXE_TYPE_LOCKED: The effect type cannot be changed after creation - you can rename it and adjust its parameters.
PRESET_NAME_PLACEHOLDER: Leave empty for an automatic name (e.g. Position_1)
PRESET_TYPE_LOCKED: The type of a preset cannot be changed after creation - you can rename it and adjust its values.
SIM3D_LIMIT_LIGHTS_TIP: How many fixtures cast their own light onto walls and floor at the same time (light spot, room light, colour bleed). 0 = unlimited: every placed fixture, as far as the graphics card can handle it.
SIM3D_LIMIT_SHADOWS_TIP: How many of these lights cast shadows (objects block the light). 0 = as many as the graphics card can; without shadows a light shines through objects, the haze still ends at walls.
SIM3D_LIMIT_SPECULAR_TIP: How many reflections on metal and mirrors are calculated. 0 = unlimited.
SIM3D_LIMIT_INFO: Now: {lights} lights, {shadows} with shadows, for {placed} fixtures. The graphics card allows up to {gpuLights} lights and {gpuShadows} shadows.
CUELIST_MANAGE_TIP: Manage all cue lists: order, rename, duplicate, delete, create
CUELIST_MANAGE_EMPTY: No cue list yet - create one above.
CUELIST_NAME_PLACEHOLDER: Leave empty for an automatic name (Cue List 1)
CUELIST_DUPE_NAME: A cue list named '{name}' already exists.
